messages:
alex kim: Heads up — I'm putting together a small Console preview for quota-aware sampling + routing dry-run. Goal: let PMs/devs preview which requests would have fallen back and the estimated cost delta before we flip the switch. Thoughts?
priya rao: Love it. Key asks: estimated cost delta, token savings, and an example list of affected route patterns (aggregate only). :+1:
jamal harris: We should also surface the number of 'unredacted inspect' events that the preview touches. But that's sensitive — prefer buckets (0, 1-10, 10+).
taylor lee: UX: show time-window selector (1h, 24h, 7d) and a TTL for any preview data. Preview must not let you download raw unredacted rows. :eyes:
alex kim: Proposed route config we can simulate (drop-in example):
```json
{
  "route": "/v1/chat",
  "sampling": {"type": "quota-aware", "percent": 12},
  "dry_run": true,
  "estimate": {"tokens_saved": "auto"}
}
```
priya rao: Nice. For telemetry, add a simulation tag so traces include "routing_simulation=true" and "simulated_fallback=true" when dry_run applies. That lets we trace impact without changing production routing.
jamal harris: Also ensure the simulator applies the same redaction policy flags as production (e.g. full-redact vs hash-pseudonymize) so the preview reflects what data would be kept.
infra-bot: CI note: config schema requires `audit_mode` to be true when `dry_run` is enabled. See internal doc: https://go/internal/docs/sampler#dryrun
taylor lee: UX nit: label the Console switch "Preview routing impact (dry-run)" and show an inline histogram: %requests affected by bucket, top 5 routes. For tenant rows show anonymized ids (hash prefix) — do not show PII.
alex kim: Action items: I will mock the Console widget and screenshots. Priya: add telemetry tags to the routing service. Jamal: build a sim harness that runs over last 7 days of sampled logs. Taylor: write copy about data privacy for preview. ETA EOD Friday?
priya rao: ETA Friday works. Also add rate-limiting on preview runs (per-employee) so we don't accidentally run full scans.
jamal harris: I'll restrict the sim to sampled logs and add an opt-in flag to run broader scans. Local dev command for iteration: 
```bash
tools/simulate-routing --route /v1/chat --dry-run --days 7 --out preview.json
```
ops-bot: FYI: when we roll canary 5% the platform will by default keep `dry_run=true` until a manual flip. Confirm before canary cutover.
alex kim: Great — I'll PR mock screenshots + behavior doc. Thanks all :rocket:
